sn48.66:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā sattaphalā satta ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
sn48.66:1.8: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭigacca aññaṃ ārādheti, atha maraṇakāle aññaṃ ārādheti.
sn48.66:1.9: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭigacca aññaṃ ārādheti, no ce maraṇakāle aññaṃ ārādheti, atha pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti,
sn48.66:1.14: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ime sattaphalā sattānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhāti.
